top_stories.title: Citrix Patches 12 NetScaler and Secure Access Client Flaws, Including Authentication Bypass
top_stories.summary: Citrix has released patches for 12 security flaws affecting NetScaler ADC, NetScaler Gateway, and NetScaler Console, including a critical authentication bypass vulnerability. The critical flaws include CVE-2026-120868 (CVSS 9.3), a memory overflow vulnerability, among others that could lead to denial-of-service or authentication bypass conditions.

top_stories.title: Calendar Invites and Live Proxies: Inside a Google Session Hijacking Campaign
top_stories.summary: A phishing campaign active since mid-August 2026 has been stealing live Google session tokens from corporate users using live proxy infrastructure to bypass traditional link-based defenses. Material Security's Threat Research team identified the operation, dubbed Operation CloudFire, and has taken down hundreds of attacker domains involved in the campaign.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Entra adds a seven-day safeguard against irreversible identity deletion
top_stories.summary: Microsoft Entra has launched Hard Deletion Protection in preview, introducing a seven-day recovery window before selected identities are permanently deleted. The feature targets both accidental and malicious identity deletion scenarios, giving administrators time to restore affected accounts before irreversible erasure occurs.

top_stories.title: Extortion Group Luna Moth Flits Into Law Firms a Second Time
top_stories.summary: The Luna Moth extortion group is targeting law firms through social engineering attacks designed to steal Microsoft access tokens. The campaign specifically retargets firms that previously refused ransom payment, using credential/token theft as the primary attack vector.

top_stories.title: AI Coding Agents Leak Thousands of Secrets to GitHub
top_stories.summary: A command in Claude Code inadvertently saves files containing credentials and other sensitive data to public GitHub repositories. The flaw creates credential exposure risks for organizations using the AI coding agent, with thousands of secrets potentially leaked.

news.title: Ory Hydra: Open-source OAuth 2.0 server and OpenID Connect provider
news.summary: Ory Hydra is an open-source OAuth 2.0 server and OpenID Connect provider designed to issue and validate tokens, register client applications, and manage signing keys. The tool intentionally stores no credentials, delegating authentication to existing identity systems while handling the full OAuth 2.0 and OIDC specification compliance layer.

news.title: The Security Jobs Growing Around Enterprise AI Agents
news.summary: The article discusses the emergence of new security roles centered on managing enterprise AI agents that now access corporate resources like email, SharePoint, and ticketing systems. The growth of AI agents performing actions across enterprise systems raises identity and access management concerns, as these non-human identities require authorization and governance controls.

news.title: FBI Says North Korean Hackers Stole Over $400 Million in Crypto Using Deepfake Video Calls
news.summary: The FBI has attributed over $400 million in cryptocurrency theft to North Korean threat actors using a social engineering scheme called FaceStealer, which employed deepfake video calls over the last 18 months. The attacks relied on identity deception tactics targeting individuals and organizations in the crypto sector.

news.title: When an AI Agent Goes Wrong, Can You Stop It?
news.summary: The article examines identity and access control challenges posed by AI agents, using a scenario where an agent with broad permissions executes unintended or malicious actions via prompt injection. The discussion centers on how traditional IAM concepts like identity, authorization, and access scope apply to—and may be insufficient for—autonomous AI systems.

news.title: SilentAir Hijacks Asian Telecom Networks to Intercept SMS 2FA Codes and Spy on Taiwanese Users
news.summary: A threat actor dubbed SilentAir has been discovered hijacking Asian telecom networks to intercept SMS-based two-factor authentication codes and communications, primarily targeting users in Taiwan. Enea, a Stockholm-based telecom cybersecurity firm, identified attack sources across at least six Asian countries and assessed with high confidence that SilentAir is a state-sponsored actor.

news.title: Operation Endgame Takes Down Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC Servers, Seizes 6.4M Stolen Logins
news.summary: An international law enforcement operation (Operation Endgame) dismantled servers used by Gootloader, CastleRAT, and StealC malware, which were used to steal credentials and deploy ransomware. Authorities seized approximately 6.4 million stolen login credentials belonging to more than 40,000 victims, according to Germany's Federal Criminal Police Office (BKA).

news.title: Cost attribution and controls for AI developer and productivity tools on Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: Amazon Bedrock offers built-in cost attribution that traces inference calls back to IAM principals, enabling per-user cost tracking for AI tools. The solution uses IAM Identity Center to attribute and control AI usage costs across developer and productivity tools.

news.title: Webinar: See How Identity Blind Spots Put Your SOC at Risk and How to Close Them
news.summary: A webinar is being promoted that addresses identity blind spots in Security Operations Centers (SOCs), focusing on challenges around identifying users, machine accounts, and AI agents during security incidents. The session covers the difficulty of correlating identity context—including access permissions—with suspicious activity in environments with high alert volumes.

news.title: New SignDrop Zero-Day Exploit Turns Windows CLFS Security Feature Into SYSTEM Access
news.summary: A proof-of-concept exploit called SignDrop has been publicly released, claiming to allow local Windows users to escalate privileges to SYSTEM level via the Common Log File System (CLFS) driver. The exploit abuses a log-authentication feature in clfs.sys by using path redirection when a privileged process opens a prepared log file.

news.title: Attacker Used 4,837 Hijacked GitHub Accounts to Run a CI Secret Stealer in 1,806+ Repositories
news.summary: An attacker used stolen credentials from 4,837 hijacked GitHub accounts to plant a secret-stealing tool across 1,806+ repositories, according to Aikido Security. The malware targeted secrets and cloud credentials accessible through CI/CD workflows in those repositories.

news.title: Fine-grained access control for Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base tools
news.summary: Amazon Web Services published guidance on implementing fine-grained access control for Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base tools exposed to AI agents via AgentCore Gateway. The approach uses a request interceptor to inject verified user identity, with AgentCore policies enforcing per-user authorization independently for MCP tool access.

news.title: Your Endpoint Management Platform Could Be Your Biggest Security Risk
news.summary: Action1 published content warning that endpoint management platforms pose significant security risks if compromised, enabling malware deployment and mass device disruption. The article promotes customer-controlled cryptographic authorization as a mitigation approach.

news.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
news.summary: Microsoft released a Patch Tuesday update addressing nearly 1,100 security vulnerabilities, including 63 critical flaws. The update includes a zero-day vulnerability in Microsoft Outlook, alongside patches from Adobe, Apple, Google, and Mozilla.
